title: narcissus papyraceus var. sequentis
intro: Narcissus papyraceus var. sequentis, commonly known as the Sanderson's narcissus, is a species of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Sanderson's narcissus include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it beneficial for conditions such as bronchitis and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
